articles.title: NASA Invites Proposals to Lease Land Parcels at Sandusky Facility

articles.title: Two Observatories, One Cosmic Eye: Hubble and Euclid View Cat’s Eye Nebula
articles.summary: This new NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image features one of the most visually intricate remnants of a dying star: the Cat’s Eye Nebula, also known as NGC 6543. This extraordinary planetary nebula lies in the constellation Draco and has captivated astronomers for decades with its elaborate and multilayered structure. Observations with ESA’s Gaia mission place the nebula at 4,400 light-years away. […]
